title: Second player's winning strategy
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a Boolean-valued winning condition $W$ on finite Boolean histories, the second player wins in $n$ steps if there is a strategy $s_2$ such that, for every strategy $s_1$ of the first player, $W$ evaluates to false on the play of length $n$ generated by these strategies.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued winning condition on finite Boolean histories
